Name: Tropical Button-Downs
Author: dizzybats
Description:
I've always been a little underwhelmed by the summer clothes available to tailor in Vanilla Stardew, and as a personal fan of Aloha shirts in real life, I wanted to add a couple in-game. 

This mod replaces the second of the craftable sailor shirts, the one made with beach shellfish, with a new blue button-down shirt with a red floral pattern, and also retextures the tropical sunrise shirt made with tropical curry so that it also is a button-down. Neither are dyeable but the crafting recipes are the same as the original shirts. 

This mod does not require Fashion Sense to work as it is a plain retexture but may conflict with mods that directly replace Stardew's main shirt png image.
